select
, IF(tfg.PORTFOLIO_ID=#{planInfo.portfolioId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 1, 99) order1 , IF(tfg.ASSET_CLASSIFY1=#{planInfo.assetClassify1, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 1, 99) order2
, IF(tfg.ASSET_CLASSIFY2=#{planInfo.assetClassify2, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 1, 99) order3
, 99 as order3
, 99 as order9
, IF(tfg.TERM_TYPE=#{planInfo.termType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 1, 99) order4
, 99 order4
, IF(tfg.CUSTOMER_ID= #{planInfo.brokerageNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 1, 99) order5
, 99 order5
, IF(tfg.SEC_ACCT_ID= #{planInfo.secAcctId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 1, 99) order6
, 99 order6
, IF(tfg.REGIST_ORG=#{planInfo.registOrg, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 1, 99) order7
, 99 order7
, IF(tfg.TRADE_PLAT= #{planInfo.tradePlatform, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 1, 99) order8
, 99 order8
from TRD_FEE_CONFIG tfg /* 交易费用配置 */ where tfg.EFF_DATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{feeDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND tfg.TRADE_MARKET = #{planInfo.tradeMarket, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND tfg.FEE_TYPE = #{planInfo.feeType, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND tfg.TRADE_TYPE = #{planInfo.tradeType, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND tfg.PS = #{planInfo.ps, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND tfg.TERM_TYPE = #{planInfo.termType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND (tfg.ASSET_CLASSIFY1 = #{planInfo.assetClassify1, jdbcType=VARCHAR} or tfg.ASSET_CLASSIFY1 = '' or tfg.ASSET_CLASSIFY1 = null)
AND (tfg.ASSET_CLASSIFY2 = #{planInfo.assetClassify2, jdbcType=VARCHAR} or tfg.ASSET_CLASSIFY2 = '' or tfg.ASSET_CLASSIFY2 = null)
ORDER BY order1, order2, order3, order4, order5, order6, order7, order8, tfg.EFF_DATE

select DISTINCT p.ACCT_NO id,s.ACCT_NAME text from PTL_CAPACCT_INFO p left join STL_CAPACCT_INFO s on p.ACCT_NO = s.ACCT_NO and p.CCY = s.CCY where p.ACCT_TYPE = 'A07'
and (p.ACCT_NO like concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%') or s.ACCT_NAME like concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%'))

SELECT #{parentId} parentInfo, null childInfo, p1.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, p3.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, s1.BUSI_ACCT_NO busiAcctNo, s1.ACCT_NAME acctName, p1.CDATE settleDate, p1.AMOUNT xiTongAmount, 'F20' finprodType
FROM PTL_CASH_POSITION p1 LEFT JOIN PTL_CAPACCT_INFO p2 ON p1.ACCT_ID = p2.ACCT_NO AND p1.CCY = p2.CCY LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO s1 ON p1.ACCT_ID = s1.ACCT_NO LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO p3 on p1.PORTFOLIO_ID = p3.PORTFOLIO_ID WHERE p2.ACCT_TYPE = 'A07' AND p1.HODING_TYPE = '03' AND s1.BUSI_ACCT_NO = #{busiAcctNo} AND p1.CDATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{settleDate},'%Y-%m-%d') AND p1.CCY = #{ccy}

SELECT #{parentId} parentInfo, null childInfo, p1.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, p3.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, sum(p1.AMOUNT) xiTongAmount FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION p1 LEFT JOIN STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO s1 ON p1.SEC_ACCT_ID = s1.SEC_ACCT_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_CAPACCT_INFO p2 ON s1.TRD_ACCT_ID = p2.ACCT_NO AND s1.TRD_ACCT_CCY = p2.CCY AND p1.PORTFOLIO_ID = p2.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO p3 on p1.PORTFOLIO_ID = p3.PORTFOLIO_ID WHERE s1.SEC_ACCT_TYPE = 'SEC' AND p1.HODING_TYPE = '03' AND p1.SEC_ACCT_ID =#{secAcctId} AND p1.FINPROD_ID =#{finprodId} AND p1.BRANCH = '0' AND p1.CDATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{settleDate},'%Y-%m-%d') GROUP BY p1.PORTFOLIO_ID, p3.PORTFOLIO_NAME

SELECT ssrd.SEQ_NO, ssrd.TRADE_ID, ssrd.INSTRUCTION_ID, ssrd.CUSTOMER_ID, ssrd.TRADE_NO, ssrd.SALE_DEPID, ssrd.SEAT_NUMBER, ssrd.PORTFOLIO_ID, ssrd.FINPROD_ID, CASE WHEN ssrd.FINPROD_TYPE IS NOT NULL THEN ssrd.FINPROD_TYPE WHEN ins.STOCK_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN 'F07' WHEN fpt.TYPE_8 IS NOT NULL THEN fpt.TYPE_8 END FINPROD_TYPE, ssrd.MARKET_ID, ssrd.FINPROD_NAME, ssrd.TRADE_MARKET, ssrd.TRADE_PLAT, ssrd.TRADE_DATE, ssrd.SETTLE_DATE, ssrd.ACCOUT, ssrd.SEC_ACCT_ID, ssrd.PS, ssrd.SETTLEMEN_TYPE, ssrd.ORDER_DATE, ssrd.CCY, IFNULL(ssrd.TRADE_NUM,0) TRADE_NUM, IFNULL(ssrd.TRADE_AMT,0) TRADE_AMT, ssrd.HAPPEN_AMT, ssrd.PRICE, ssrd.FULL_PRICE, ssrd.UNIT, ssrd.INT_AMT, ssrd.HGDQJE, ssrd.HGDQR, IFNULL(ssrd.STAMP_FEE,0) STAMP_FEE, IFNULL(ssrd.JSF_AMT,0) JSF_AMT, IFNULL(ssrd.GHF_AMT,0) GHF_AMT, IFNULL(ssrd.ZGF_AMT,0) ZGF_AMT, IFNULL(ssrd.SXF_AMT,0) SXF_AMT, IFNULL(ssrd.SETTLE_FEE,0) SETTLE_FEE, IFNULL(ssrd.TRADE_FEE,0) TRADE_FEE, IFNULL(ssrd.COMMISSION_AMT,0) COMMISSION_AMT, IFNULL(ssrd.TOTAL_TEEAMT,0) TOTAL_TEEAMT FROM STL_SEC_RECON_DEAL ssrd LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt ON ssrd.FINPROD_ID = fpt.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN T_INSTRUMENT ins ON ssrd.FINPROD_ID = ins.STOCK_CODE WHERE ssrd.SEQ_NO = #{seqNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
